sonnet.problem: The story card says Paul points to 'one body with many parts.' That hands over the answer to the next choice card (card 6), which asks the believers who are many are 'one what?' (Body). It also rules out the wrong answers Vine and Flock.
sonnet.rule: No card ever gives away the answer to a choice card that comes later.

sonnet.problem: The setup says Paul's word is 'about how each of them sizes himself up.' That points straight at 'Think too highly of themselves' in card 2 and rules out the wrong answers 'Trust their own feelings' and 'Worry about their own needs.'
sonnet.rule: A setup line can't rule out the wrong answers either.

sonnet.problem: The card says the disobedience and what God does about it 'makes him burst into praise.' Romans 11:30-36 gives no such cause. It adds a reason for Paul's praise that the text does not state.
sonnet.rule: He never adds why someone did, said or thought something unless the text says why.
